import java.util.*;
import java.io.*;

public class Main {
    static final long MOD = 1000000007L;
    static int n_size;
    static long[][] A_matrix;
    static long[][][] T_arr;
    static List<Map<Long, Long>> DP_map;
    static int[] family_count_mask;
    static int[] family_id_mask;
    static List<List<Integer>> family_mask_list;

    static long sum_mod(long a, long b) {
        return (a + b) % MOD;
    }

    static long diff_mod(long a, long b) {
        a -= b;
        return (a < 0) ? a + MOD : a;
    }

    static long product_mod(long a, long b) {
        return (a * b) % MOD;
    }

    static long pow_mod(long base, long exp) {
        long result = 1;
        long cur = base;
        while (exp > 0) {
            if ((exp & 1) == 1) {
                result = product_mod(result, cur);
            }
            cur = product_mod(cur, cur);
            exp >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static long inv_mod(long x) {
        return pow_mod(x, MOD - 2);
    }

    static void prepare() {
        family_mask_list = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n_size; i++) {
            family_mask_list.add(new ArrayList<>());
        }
        for (int mask = 1; mask < (1 << n_size); ++mask) {
            family_count_mask[mask] = family_count_mask[mask >> 1] + (mask & 1);
        }
        for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n_size); ++mask) {
            family_id_mask[mask] = family_mask_list.get(family_count_mask[mask]).size();
            family_mask_list.get(family_count_mask[mask]).add(mask);
        }
        T_arr = new long[n_size + 1][1 << n_size][1 << n_size];
        for (int k = 0; k <= n_size; ++k) {
            for (int i = 0; i < family_mask_list.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                int cm = family_mask_list.get(k).get(i);
                for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << n_size); ++mask) {
                    long ans = 0;
                    if ((mask & cm) == mask) continue;
                    for (int x = 0; x < n_size; ++x) {
                        if ((cm & (1 << x)) != 0) continue;
                        if ((mask & (1 << x)) == 0) continue;
                        int newmask = cm | (1 << x);
                        ans |= (1L << family_id_mask[newmask]);
                    }
                    T_arr[k][i][mask] = ans;
                }
            }
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) throws IOException {
        BufferedReader br = new BufferedReader(new InputStreamReader(System.in));
        n_size = Integer.parseInt(br.readLine());
        A_matrix = new long[n_size][n_size];
        for (int i = 0; i < n_size; ++i) {
            String[] parts = br.readLine().split(" ");
            for (int j = 0; j < n_size; ++j) {
                long val = Long.parseLong(parts[j]);
                A_matrix[i][j] = product_mod(val, inv_mod(100));
            }
        }
        family_count_mask = new int[1 << n_size];
        family_id_mask = new int[1 << n_size];
        prepare();

        DP_map = new ArrayList<>();
        for (int i = 0; i <= n_size; ++i) {
            DP_map.add(new HashMap<>());
        }
        DP_map.get(0).put(1L, 1L);

        for (int k = 0; k < n_size; ++k) {
            Map<Long, Long> currentDP = DP_map.get(k);
            Map<Long, Long> nextDP = DP_map.get(k + 1);
            for (int edges = 0; edges < (1 << n_size); ++edges) {
                long prob = 1;
                for (int i = 0; i < n_size; ++i) {
                    if (((edges & (1 << i)) != 0))
                        prob = product_mod(prob, A_matrix[k][i]);
                    else
                        prob = product_mod(prob, diff_mod(1, A_matrix[k][i]));
                }
                for (Map.Entry<Long, Long> entry : currentDP.entrySet()) {
                    long mask = entry.getKey();
                    long val = entry.getValue();
                    long p = product_mod(prob, val);
                    long newmask = 0;
                    for (int i = 0; i < family_mask_list.get(k).size(); ++i) {
                        if ((mask & (1L << i)) != 0)
                            newmask |= T_arr[k][i][edges];
                    }
                    if (newmask != 0) {
                        nextDP.put(newmask, sum_mod(nextDP.getOrDefault(newmask, 0L), p));
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        System.out.println(DP_map.get(n_size).getOrDefault(1L, 0L));
    }
}
